FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Surplus Army Gear specializes in the retail sales of military and navy surplus items sourced exclusively from domestic government auctions and approved military surplus wholesalers. Our operations include a diverse inventory ranging from clothing, gear, and outdoor equipment to tactical accessories, ensuring compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations. We maintain a strong emphasis on safety and security through comprehensive fire and water protection systems, such as sprinklers and alarm systems, while ensuring that high-value inventory is stored in secured areas. Our team undergoes regular training in regulatory compliance and safe handling of military surplus goods. Additionally, we have implemented a robust inventory management system that tracks item origins and values, guaranteeing continuous assessment of our inventory through annual appraisals. Online sales are managed with encrypted payment processing to ensure customer data protection. Overall, our commitment to regulatory compliance and safety helps us minimize risks while providing quality products to our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, we experienced a theft incident resulting in a loss of $1,500. Items taken included clothing and tactical gear. The case is currently under investigation by local law enforcement. Additionally, on July 5, 2023, water damage caused by a plumbing issue resulted in a loss of $1,000. The damage has been repaired, and the issue has been addressed to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9 AM - 7 PM; Sunday: 10 AM - 5 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secured Fireproof Safe, Class 0, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Monitoring and Regular Security Patrols
